title: Bar Salts Strawberry Ice Flavour Concentrate 10ml By Vampire Vape
description: Vampire Vape’s Bar Salts Strawberry Ice flavour concentrate offers a cool twist on the classic strawberry flavour, featuring a hint of ice to enhance the summer berry sweetness. This 10ml bottle provides a delightful, crisp strawberry taste with a refreshing finish. This concentrate is designed for vapers who enjoy making their own e-liquids. Add it to a VG/PG base, tweak the nicotine strength with optional Nic Shots, and shake to create a personalized vape juice that’s both flavourful and satisfying. Designed for vapers who enjoy crafting their blends, this 100% PG concentrate provides the foundation for a personalized vape experience. Adjust the nicotine level and VG/PG ratios to your liking by adding nicotine shots and a VG/PG base to achieve the perfect balance. Mix this concentrate with a VG/PG base of your choice and add nicotine shots as desired to achieve your perfect vape, with recommended dilution rates between 15-20% to suit your taste. Produced in the UK, this high-quality concentrate is designed for optimal flavour accuracy and mixing versatility. Please Note: This flavour concentrate is not intended to be vaped on its own. These concentrates are for personal use and are not to be used for commercial purposes.
